comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 Bf5 4. e3 e6 5. Nf3 c5 6. Nb5 Na6 7. c3
comments.comment:
c3 takes the c-pawn off the d1-a4 diagonal, so the queen can come to a4, and it covers b4 and d4.
With the c8-bishop on f5 and the knight on a6, nothing stands on c6 or d7: the a4-e8 diagonal to Black's king is open.
Against ...c4, Qa4 puts the queen behind the b5-knight, and Black has to block the diagonal.
The same Qa4 against ...Nh5: (7... Nh5 8. Qa4 Nxf4 9. Nd6+ Ke7 10. Nxf5+ exf5 11. exf4)
After ...cxd4, Nbxd4 hits the f5-bishop and opens Bb5+: (7... cxd4 8. Nbxd4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 Bf5 4. e3 e6 5. Nf3 c5 6. Nb5 Na6 7. c3 c4 8. Qa4 Nd7 9. b3
comments.comment:
b3 hits the c4-pawn, and Nd6+ comes next: after ...Bxd6 Bxd6, our bishop covers f8, so Black can't castle.
Against ...Be7, Nd6+ at once: (9... Be7 10. Nd6+ Bxd6 11. Bxd6)
Against ...Bd3, take on c4: (9... Bd3 10. bxc4)

comments.comment: Against ...Qb6 or ...Rc8, Ne5 hits the d7-knight: (10... Qb6 11. Ne5) (10... Rc8 11. Ne5)

comments.comment:
The d6-bishop covers f8, so Black can't castle. Against ...Qb6, which hits it, Ba3 keeps it on the f8 diagonal. Against ...Nc7, Ne5 hits the d7-knight, which our queen pins.
(12... Qb6 13. Ba3) (12... Nc7 13. Ne5)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 Bf5 4. e3 e6 5. Nf3 c5 6. Nb5 Na6 7. c3 c4 8. Qa4 Qd7 9. Ne5
comments.comment:
Ne5 hits the queen, and it can't stay on the diagonal: once it leaves, Nc7+ or Nd6+ is a double check.
(9... Qd8 10. Nc7+) (9... Qc8 10. Nd6+) (9... Qe7 10. Nd6+)
Against ...Bc2, which hits our queen, b3 blocks: (9... Bc2 10. b3)
